name: 85373 · Sun City, AZ
findings: ZIP 85373 (Sun City) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85373 (Sun City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85373 (Sun City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
